title: docs(qa): 18.0 sweep anchor round 3 — the approvals token door after the reminder link removal, a consumed-changeset citation, and §3 accuracy corrections in six areas
body:
Refs #24579
Clause-②: no

The third dispatch of the 18.0 release sweep's wave anchor: one PR in three parts, checklist ledger only. It changes the seven `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` files the claim names and nothing else: no product code, no test, no pin. Each edited item takes one `revision` bump and one `history` row naming the run records it rests on. Every finding was re-derived from source at base `9a7838edf5` (merged up to `origin/main` `7c7741dcb4` before this PR opened) before an edit, and the console claims were read on objectui. Findings that did not hold are listed below with the reading that refuted them.

The history rows carry the placeholder ref `#PENDING-24579R3`, because the PR has no number until it is created. A follow-up commit on this branch swaps exactly those strings for this PR's number.

## Part (a): §1's last row, after PR #24620

PR #24620 (`65a8eeb7d4`, the repair of #24564) took the one-tap link off the reminder payload. On main `remind()` mints no token and attaches no link, `issueActionTokens` has no production caller, and no REST door reaches it, so no stock boot holds a live action token. The live-token legs move to the pins, now named per clause in a new `automated.ref`. The live run keeps three legs: the at-rest read (the reminder row carries no link), the `token=garbage` page, and the anonymous-client proof. `act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate`'s `fixtures.requires` follows; #24620 refutes QA run #24542's reading that the raw links sit in `sys_notification.payload.actions`.

## Findings left alone, with the reading that refuted each

- `cli.migrate-meta-codemod` knownGaps[2] (#24551). The finding said `ObjectSchema.create()` and `definePermissionSet()` throw on a planted retired key before the chain runs. Under `os migrate meta`, the authored-source shim (`packages/cli/src/utils/config.ts` `authoredSourcePlugin`, since `d2b188fb57`, an ancestor of `5b14b7f3`) makes every `define*` helper and the `STRICT_AUTHORING_FACTORIES` (`ObjectSchema` / `App` / `Dashboard` / `Report` / `Action` `.create`) tolerant, and hands the authored argument through. It wraps nothing only when `@objectstack/spec` does not resolve from the config's directory (`authoredSourceHelpersOf` answers empty), which is a fault in the scratch tree. The knownGap's wording holds.
- `api-backend.batch-transactional-discovery` step 4 (#24541), the claim that the step 'may not exercise a real rollback'. `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` runs only the API gate before `ql.transaction`, then runs each op's `engine.insert` in order inside it. The first create is therefore written before the invalid invoice's required-field validation fails, and that failure rolls it back.
- The `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=object` half of `api-backend.api-methods-verb-gate`'s fixtures finding (#24541), and the `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=flow` half of `automation.flow-registration-verdict-on-read`'s (#24545). The registry declares `object` and `flow` `allowRuntimeCreate: true` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts`), and `saveMetaItem`'s code-only gate consults the hatch only for a type that is not runtime-creatable, so a NEW item needs no hatch. QA run #24558 authored scratch objects with no hatch. The other halves of both findings were taken.
- `cli.build-own-contract` acceptance[3] ('issues' vs 'errors', #24551). The verify already states `{ success: false, … issues }`, and the clause scopes parity to the warnings and conversions keys, which match (the run scored it pass).
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`. The 'comment-reactions still runs' row (#24558) is consistent: the item already scores `os migrate comment-reactions --apply` twice. The whole-item rewrite and the `release-refusal` pin are on main via #24622.
- `cli.migrate-meta-write-stored-and-all` --all leg (#24551). steps[2] already says 'on a stack without jobs/agents'.
- `cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts` (#24558, 'both non-zero, clause holds') and `cli.dev-boot-contract` (#24556, 'all as steps[8] states') are accurate as written.
- `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18`. Clause 2's PUT 422 and the job / api code-only 403 (#24545, #24558) are on main via #24622 (revision 2).
- `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable` (#24556, runs `limit` capped at 100) and `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` (#24540, `query_records` limit capped at 50). No step in either item passes a limit, so the cap is never reached.
- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` tools/list (#24556, 9 tools including `aggregate_records`). The knownGap is conditional ('if tools/list lacks aggregate_records') and holds.
- `automation.scheduled-work-opt-in` (#24558, `=1` vs `true`). Both values are truthy (`resolveScheduledWorkEnabled`), so the item is accurate.
- `i18n.surface-matrix` tenant-locale route (#24553). steps[17] and the clause verify already spell `PUT /api/settings/localization` with no `/v1`, which `service-settings/src/settings-route-ledger.ts` confirms ('NOT under /api/v1').
- `i18n.flow-copy-translation-and-host-override`: the record-triggered refusal stays in English (#24553 observation). acceptance[1] already states it ('record-trigger refusals stay in the source language').
- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` (#24541, two observations), `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` (#24541, membershipCreated) and `api-backend.data-request-shape-and-query-arity` codes (#24558, 'both as stated'). None of them is an item claim.
- `approvals.email-action-token-door`. #24542's dead-slot and expired notes are moot: the live dead-slot leg is pin-scored now, and the expired leg was already pinned.
- Fixture-boot spelling notes (`pnpm dev -- --fresh` vs the canonical file-DB boot) on `cli.qa-suite-execution`, `cli.meta-package-flags-and-explain`, `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`, `i18n.flow-copy-translation-and-host-override`, `automation.flow-registration-verdict-on-read` and `ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure`. Each record says the canonical boot 'works equally' or had 'no effect on verdict', so these are suggestions and the items are accurate. Round 2 treated them the same way.
- Scope suggestions, not inaccuracies: `ux-conventions.write-feedback` ('package create and Save as draft give navigation feedback — not listed variants'), and `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` ('Seen, not in the listed variants … a future revision decides scope').

## Gates

The gate list was derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff (13 families, 7 paths against merge base `7c7741dcb`). All 13 were run at `f8fe79c742`, with each exit code captured before any pipe, and every one exited 0: `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity --self-test`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe` and `check:watch-hint-literal`. The `--ran` reconciliation reads: '13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN'.

`check:platform-checklist` runs in no per-PR CI, so this local reading is its evidence: `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 327 items (322 active, 1 planned)`. Symbol anchors went from 873/883 at base `9a7838edf5` to 875/885 at head: 2 added, 0 lost, 10 on the #16898 residual, and all 18 file floors held (PM hypothesis 3). The two new anchors come from `cli.dev-automigrate-policy` `source[3]`, which now names the decision's home and its three readers. `approval-service.ts#approver` became `#remind`, so that swap leaves the count unchanged.

No record finding names this item, so it is noted for the anchor and not edited.

It is handed back in the report for the seat to route.
- PM hypothesis 1 holds in part. Between the run subjects and the merged head, the cited sources moved under four findings: the reminder payload (#24620 `65a8eeb7d4`, part (a)); the resume route, which now refuses `inputs` + `variables` together (#24594 `c3954057fe`, the repair of #24546) and so re-spelled trigger-status-contract steps[5]; a batch row that answers a hook's own words (#24631, the repair of #24561); and the in-memory bucket, which now keeps a `Field.date` on its day (#24642 `787939130c`, merged in from main, the repair of #24618). Each of those items' history rows says which. The other cited sources changed only in code these findings do not read; the facts were spot-checked at the merged head.
